PyTorch domain libraries provide a number of pre-loaded datasets (such as FashionMNIST) that subclass and implement functions specific to the particular data. They can be used to prototype and benchmark your model. You can find them here: Image Datasets, Text Datasets, and Audio Datasets

Loading a Dataset

Here is an example of how to load the Fashion-MNIST dataset from TorchVision. Fashion-MNIST is a dataset of Zalando's article images consisting of 60,000 training examples and 10,000 test examples. Each example comprises a 28x28 grayscale image and an associated label from one of 10 classes.
